description.value: Tacofino is the West Coast Mexican food brand that got its start in Tofino, built around a beach-casual menu of tacos and burritos inspired by surf culture. The brand now has two Tofino presences — the original food truck on Pacific Rim Highway and a newer town-centre location on Campbell Street — both offering quick counter-service meals. For cyclists riding the Pacific Rim corridor, either stop provides a well-known, no-fuss refuelling option.
